text: Rectal prolapse: often gets attacked (cannibalized) by other pigs, so the affected pig should be isolated in an individual pen; replace the prolapse and secure it with a purse-string suture. Uterine prolapse (technically a prolapse of the cervix): occurs in advanced pregnancy when increased abdominal pressure pushes tissue out through the vulva; replace the prolapse and close the vulva with a suture, leaving about a 25 cm loop, tied loosely enough to be released easily if farrowing begins.
